Bug_Title: QBA: Method assigns boolean literal in boolean expression (QBA_QUESTIONABLE_BOOLEAN_ASSIGNMENT)
Bug_Details:
This method assigns a literal boolean value (true or false) to a boolean variable inside
an if or while expression. Most probably this was supposed to be a boolean comparison using
==, not an assignment using =.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the boolean variable'result' is assigned the literal value 'true' inside the if condition instead of being compared.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method of BooleanAssignmentBug class. Since the showBug method contains a bug where the boolean variable'result' is incorrectly assigned the literal value 'true' instead of being compared, the method always returns true. The assertFalse assertion in the test case expects the method to return false, causing the test to fail and thus triggering the bug.
